Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Booking.name: Booking
Booking.comment:
A booking that holds a slot of its desk while it waits (D70, D103's step
4): entering held takes the slot through the contract Supply the desk
implements, booked commits it, expired and cancelled let it go.

fields.name: holdsState
fields.description: The least advanced state of the items: none before any is asked, then pending, held, committed, released or returned. A rule hears it turn committed.

fields.name: holdsTotal
fields.description: The sum of the priced items' unit prices times their quantities, as { amount, currency }: an item without a price adds nothing, and with none priced it is { amount: 0, currency: null }. Null only when the priced items' currencies differ or the sum passes what a JSON number holds exactly.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: statusEnteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

BookingHoldsItems.name: BookingHoldsItems
BookingHoldsItems.comment: On a table, each item the claim has taken, keyed by its hold and index: the supply it names, what it asks, its state and the unit price the supply held it at, and the Workflow entry it was taken at. An item its fields ask that it has not taken is no row; the items field shows it pending.

fields.name: booking
fields.description: The Booking row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The hold's name and the item's index, joined by /.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: The hold's name.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item's index in its hold.

fields.name: supplySchema
fields.description: The supply's type.

fields.name: supplyId
fields.description: The supply's key.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The units of counted supply it asks.

fields.name: startMs
fields.description: When the time it asks starts, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: endMs
fields.description: When the time it asks ends, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: state
fields.description: pending, held, committed, released or returned.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: The unit price the supply held it at, in the currency's minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The unit price's currency.

fields.name: takenAt
fields.description: The Workflow's enteredAt at the take, which tells a later entry of a takeOn state from this one.

Desk.name: Desk
Desk.comment:
A desk whose time Calendar opens (D70, D103's step 4): weekday hours in
Europe/London, one booking at a time, a quarter-hour grid, holds of a
quarter of an hour to two hours, and its own hours and closures set by a
caller holding desk.manage. Its record of each booking it holds, its
closures and its own settings are sub-tables of the row.

DeskCalendarBookings.name: DeskCalendarBookings
DeskCalendarBookings.comment: On a table, the supply's record of each claim item that holds or held time of the row, keyed by the claim's type and key, the hold and the item's index: the interval it asked, its state, which a call moves only forward, so a call made again changes nothing, and when it last moved. A deleted claim's records retire under a key of their own, its committed time still booked, so a claim created again with its key holds afresh.

fields.name: desk
fields.description: The Desk row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: record
fields.description: The claim's type, its key, the hold and the item's index, joined by /; a retired record's has # and a key of its own after it.

fields.name: holderSchema
fields.description: The claim's type.

fields.name: holderId
fields.description: The claim's key.

fields.name: hold
fields.description: The hold's name in the claim's Holds config.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item's index in its hold.

fields.name: startMs
fields.description: When the time it asked starts, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: endMs
fields.description: When the time it asked ends, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: state
fields.description: held, committed or released.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.description: A price the supply held it at; Calendar gives none.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The price's currency; Calendar gives none.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it last moved, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: retired
fields.description: Whether it is a deleted claim's.

DeskCalendarClosures.name: DeskCalendarClosures
DeskCalendarClosures.comment: On a table, the row's closures, keyed by their name, closure-1 onward: when each starts and ends, why, who made it and when.

fields.name: desk
fields.description: The Desk row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: closure
fields.description: The closure's name.

fields.name: startMs
fields.description: When it starts, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: endMs
fields.description: When it ends, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why, as the caller gave it.

fields.name: by
fields.description: The subject of the caller who made it.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When it was made, in epoch milliseconds.

DeskCalendarSettings.name: DeskCalendarSettings
DeskCalendarSettings.comment: On a table, what setOpeningHours and addClosure set of the row, keyed by name: hours, the row's own weekly hours; timeZone, its own zone; closuresMade, how many closures it has made, which names the next. A name with no row follows the config.

fields.name: desk
fields.description: The Desk row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: name
fields.description: hours, timeZone or closuresMade.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Its value: the hours by day, the zone's IANA name, or the count.
